bengal.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the exact monument design reference for cin-bahia. Image 2 is only the BENGAL stone reference. Create one clean frontal catalogue master, preserving the complete design and every structural component and proportion. Preserve the simple upright rectangular headstone with a straight horizontal top, the broad transverse rear step supporting it, the rectangular upper slab in front of that step, and the wider rectangular lower plinth. Keep the light coarse-grained lower plinth and rear step as fixed secondary stone; only the blue-grey headstone and upper slab are the variable primary stone. Change only the main upright headstone and the upper rectangular horizontal slab, which are blue-grey granite in the source to the exact polished black Bengal granite with natural silver and grey crystalline grain from image 2. Keep the lower projecting plinth and the full rear transverse step in their original light grey-white coarse crystalline stone. Preserve both material boundaries and all joints. No removable accessories or surface decorations are present. Camera exactly centered on the longitudinal axis, no left or right yaw, main front upright surface parallel to image plane. Use parallel orthographic projection with modest elevation only to reveal the base, no three-quarter view. Entire monument visible with balanced margins. Uniform pale grey studio background and soft contact shadow, gentle light, no glare obscuring surfaces. Do not invent components, text, ornaments, flowers, plants, vases or watermarks. Single square image requested 2048x2048. Fixed geometry master for nine material-only edits.
bengal.controleVisuel: Source BAHIA inspectee. Stele rectangulaire verticale, dalle superieure, semelle debordante et marche arriere conservees. Bengal applique uniquement a la stele et a la dalle superieure; semelle et marche gardent leur pierre claire a gros cristaux. Cadrage frontal, sans accessoires ni gravure. Pilote non calibre.
